title: CIA and ODNI open-source intelligence system reportedly hit by cyber intrusion, officials say no classified information exposed
date_note: US media reports are dated 24 November by the Kyodo and CBS Nocut articles (published 25 November); the date of the intrusion is not stated.
place: Washington, DC, United States (Kyodo dateline; location of the system not stated)
summary: CBS Nocut News says the AP reported a cyberattack on a CIA unclassified system used to analyse publicly available material. Outlook India, relaying the New York Times, says the system is also used by ODNI and the NGA, and that unnamed people familiar with the matter believe the Artex AI tool was involved. Investigators have not identified who was responsible.
plain: Outlets relaying US media say an open-source intelligence system used by the CIA, ODNI and NGA was hit by a cyber intrusion. Classified information was reportedly not affected. Investigators have not named who was responsible.
exec: A reported intrusion at an unclassified US intelligence system; per Outlook India, relaying the NYT, classified material was not affected and no one has been identified as responsible.

validation.note: Three pages (CBS Nocut News relaying AP, Kyodo via Kanaloco relaying US media, Asharq Al-Awsat relaying the New York Times) are all relays; no English original, CIA or ODNI page was read.
